Sam: Bringing up a new GPU cluster in ap-south-2 (8x A100 nodes). Need a lightweight runbook for logs/metrics/traces + dashboards and an explicit handoff to SRE. Who can own what? :wave:
Tara: I can own dashboards+alerting. Want a short checklist I can follow and verify.
Liam: I'll handle collection and pipeline bootstrap (Vector -> Cortex/Thanos -> Tempo). Quick notes: prefer Vector as daemonset for logs/metrics, remote_write to Cortex, traces to Tempo. Posting the minimal bootstrap commands below.
Liam: ```bash
# vector daemonset (nodes)
kubectl apply -f infra/observability/vector-daemonset.yaml -n observability
# prometheus (k8s service discovery + remote_write)
kubectl apply -f infra/observability/prometheus-k8s.yaml -n observability
# tempo for traces
kubectl apply -f infra/observability/tempo.yaml -n observability
```
Priya: Cost note: metrics cardinality + retention = main cost driver. For this region I recommend: 30d raw metrics, 180d downsampled (6h), traces 14d by default. Use S3 lifecycle to move older objects to Glacier and enable compression on vector. Also watch cross-region egress if S3 bucket is not in ap-south-2.
Sam: Networking constraints: cluster in private subnets with no public nodes. We need either NAT Gateway for egress or VPC endpoints for S3 and STS. Also consider interface endpoints for Cortex remote_write to reduce egress. Can infra-provision VPC endpoints?
Liam: Yes — we should create S3 gateway endpoint + interface endpoints for KMS and STS. If using managed Cortex in another region, NAT will be required and costs may spike.
Tara: Alerts we should include at handoff (high priority): GPU memory exhaustion, node OOM, Vector crashloop, Prometheus scrape failures, Cortex write latency. Example alert (Prometheus rule):
Tara: ```yaml
- alert: NodeGPUMemoryHigh
  expr: sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) / sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes) > 0.9
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU memory >90% on {{ $labels.node }}"
```
Priya: Add a billing alert when storage > X GB/month in ap-south-2 so we get a pager before costs spike. We should also tag metrics/logs with cluster and team for chargeback.
Liam: Validation quick checks after deploy:
Liam: ```bash
kubectl get pods -n observability
# expect all vector/prometheus/tempo pods Ready=1/1
kubectl port-forward svc/grafana -n observability 3000:80 &
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health | jq .
# check sample metrics endpoint
curl -s http://prometheus.observability.svc:9090/metrics | head -n 20
```
infra-bot: CI:observability-bootstrap job succeeded for cluster/ap-south-2 — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-obs-artifacts/ap-south-2/bootstrap-1779504321.tar.gz :white_check_mark:
Priya: Preliminary cost estimate from the bootstrap run: ~200GB/month storage, ~0.8 vCPU-hours for scraping per node. I'll add a conservative buffer to the committed spend request. Confluence draft: https://confluence.internal/redwood/ap-south-2-observability-costs
Sam: Handoff checklist (to include in runbook):
1) Confirm Vector sees stdout/stderr logs + node exporters
2) Verify Prometheus remote_write -> Cortex (test write)
3) Query traces in Tempo (sample trace end-to-end)
4) Import Grafana dashboards and verify panels
5) Fire alert smoke tests (simulate scrape failure, GPU pressure)
6) Update oncall rotation and escalation docs, tag @oncall-sre
Tara: I'll schedule a 30m handoff tomorrow 11:00 PDT and attach the dashboard links after provisioning. I'll also add the alert rules to the repo: infra/observability/alerts/ap-south-2-rules.yaml
infra-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/ap-south-2-observability.md (rb-202603). Next step: owner assignment -> Tara (dashboards/alerts) + Liam (collection/pipeline) + Priya (costs/retention).
Sam: Perfect — I'll add the SRE oncall and mark this ready for handoff. :thumbsup:
